response:
Reflection: two constructions now define the frontier and they excel on different metrics. Adding a *profitability-momentum* leg to the chronic-accrual composite produced the archive's best alpha (6.0%) and best high-coverage Sharpe (0.545), while industry demeaning of the two-leg chronic composite produced the best alpha t-stat (6.09) and the rank-product form the best FMB slope (6.10). These three corrections — momentum leg, industry demeaning, multiplicative geometry — have never been combined, and each addresses a separate weakness: economic magnitude, sector noise, and slope precision. Dollar-netting is now conclusively the weakest geometry (FMB 2.48) and I abandon it. This penultimate batch consolidates the momentum-plus-chronic-accrual family along those axes and adds one distinct accrual channel (accrual deceleration) plus one horizon test of the improvement leg.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: IndNeutralMomentumChronicQuality
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(IND_ADJ(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at)), SUMRANK(IND_ADJ(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), 1)), IND_ADJ(NEG(MA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), at), 3)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Within its industry, a firm that is profitable, becoming more profitable, and chronically free of accrual reliance offers the most credible evidence of durable earnings, because the margin improvement is verified by cash rather than by accounting estimates.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This unites the archive's best alpha driver (the momentum leg, 6.0%) with its best reliability driver (industry demeaning of all legs, alpha t=6.09), corrections that target economic magnitude and sector noise respectively. Industry demeaning of the margin-change leg is especially motivated because margin improvements are strongly cyclical within sectors.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: MomentumQualityWideCoverage
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), SUMRANK(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), 1), MA(COALESCE(RATIO(ADD(recch, ADD(invch, apalch)), at), NEG(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), at))), 3)))
HYPOTHESIS: Using the reported cash-flow-statement accrual where available and the balance-sheet accrual otherwise, averaged over three years, gives the cleanest habitual cash-conversion measure to validate a firm's margin level and margin improvement.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The cash-flow-preferred accrual leg is the only construction that raised coverage to 0.122 while retaining an alpha t above 5.6, and it has never been paired with the momentum leg that lifted alpha to 6.0%. If alpha and Sharpe hold at the wider coverage, this is the more robust final candidate because it is least exposed to a particular sample era or reporting regime.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: MomentumChronicPercentAccrual
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), SUMRANK(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), 1), NEG(MA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), WINSOR(ABS(ib), 1)), 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: Margin improvement is trustworthy only when the firm habitually reports a small fraction of its earnings as accruals, so scaling the smoothed accrual by earnings rather than assets should sharpen the discrimination between real and manufactured improvement.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The earnings-scaled deflator repeatedly delivered the strongest Sharpe within each family it was tried in, and this isolates that single design choice inside the current best-alpha construction. Comparing it against Signal 2 tells us whether deflator choice or accrual data source matters more once momentum is in the composite.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: ProfitTrendChronicAccrual
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), SUMRANK(TREND(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), 5), NEG(MA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), at), 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: A multi-year upward trajectory in margins is a stronger indicator of competitive improvement than a single-year change, and when it coincides with chronic accrual restraint it identifies businesses whose earnings power is genuinely and durably rising.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The one-year margin change added substantial alpha, but we cannot tell whether that reflects genuine multi-year improvement or short-horizon earnings momentum that decays; a five-year trend distinguishes the two. Matching the improvement horizon to the persistence horizon of the accrual leg also makes the composite economically coherent.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: ProfitWithAccrualDeceleration
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), SUMRANK(NEG(MA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), at), 3)), NEG(DELTA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), at), 1))))
HYPOTHESIS: Beyond the chronic level of accrual reliance, the direction of change matters: a profitable firm whose accrual intensity is decelerating is tightening its accounting and converting more of each profit dollar to cash, whereas accelerating accruals foreshadow reversal.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Every accrual leg tested so far measures a level or an average level, never the change in accrual intensity, so this is a distinguishable dynamic channel on the accrual side rather than the profitability side. It also provides the cleanest read on whether the momentum gain discovered in gen 7 comes specifically from the profitability leg or from any recent-change information.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: RankProductChronicPercentAccrual
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at)), IND_RANK(NEG(MA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), WINSOR(ABS(ib), 1)), 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: The multiplicative form of industry-relative margin and industry-relative chronic percent accruals should maximize cross-sectional slope precision, since credibility scales the profitability premium rather than adding to it.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The rank product with the asset-scaled smoothed accrual delivered the best FMB t in the archive (6.10) with a 5.8 alpha t-stat, and the earnings-scaled deflator has improved every additive variant it was applied to, but the two have not been combined. This is the sharpest remaining candidate for a signal that is simultaneously top on the cross-sectional and portfolio criteria.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite
